render_model_pybullet: render a pybullet physics model with links, joints, and joint geometry using OpenGL
render_geom_visual_shape: render a pybullet visual shape like sphere, box, capsule, cylinder, or mesh geometry
render_links_pybullet_model: render all links of a pybullet model with optional color filtering and wireframe overlay
render_contacts_pybullet: render contact point arrows for a pybullet model showing collision forces and normals
render_meshes_obj: render a dictionary of OBJ mesh materials with OpenGL lighting and vertex arrays
